title: potentilla recta var. astracanica
intro: Potentilla recta var. astracanica, commonly known as a variety of the potentilla plant, is a perennial herb that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla recta var. astracanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant may help to treat various health conditions, including wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues.
